newsitem.title: MOROCCO: French Accor to buy nine Moroccan hotels.
newsitem.headline: French Accor to buy nine Moroccan hotels.

text.p: French hotel group Accor on Thursday signed a agreement with Moroccan authorities to buy nine hotels and invest more than $100 million in current tourism projects, a finance ministry official said.

"Accor's managing director Jean Robert Reznik and Finance Minister Mohamed Kabbaj signed an agreement on Thursday which will enable the French group to purchase nine hotels and manage three large other units," the official told Reuters.
The group is also expected to invest more than $100 million in developing tourism and leisure facilities in Morocco's economic and financial capital of Casablanca, the official said.
Accor will take charge of management of hotel complexes in the southern cities of Marrakesh, Agadir, Zagora and Ouarzazate, he said.
The group will set up a Thalassotherapy unit in Essaouira, on the Atlantic coast, the ministry said.
It took nearly one year to finalise the agreement, officials said.
The group will purchase the three-star Moussafir hotel network located mainly in tourist cities such as Marrakesh, Fez, Agadir, Rabat, Oujda and Casablanca.
